ops.old: Baby carrots roasted at 200C with honey and thyme until sticky, served with a whipped feta dip. Toss 500g baby carrots with honey, thyme and oil and roast at 200C for 25 minutes until sticky. Whip 150g feta with 150g Greek yoghurt until smooth. Serve the carrots warm around the dip. Keep one aside for a snowman's nose.
